unit.why: The division is a chain of homilies and verse interpretations attributed to Hasidic masters (Peshischa, Przedbórz, Radoszyce and others), including a king-parable embedded in exegesis, with no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: The division begins mid-sequence of numbered sayings from the previous division; the next division opens a short deathbed anecdote about the Radoszyce tsaddik.
